The documented behavior is consistent with the canonical model. App Attest setup guidance is explicitly not a grant. New identities need macOS 27+ and qualified App Attest. The legacy MDM path stays limited to frozen identities (TB-011, T-052, T-057). Logout sends the provider token only to its recorded issuer, over a 10s no-redirect request. It confirms revocation only on 204, and the URL authority cannot be altered by path text (TB-002, A-008, T-039). `darkbloom report` redacts logs and drops key identifiers and paths from the device-wide DeviceCheck evidence (T-058). The model-verification I/O text says complete integrity checks are retained (T-012, T-027). The prefix-cache text is limited to KV layout and does not alter the TTL, disk budget or HMAC-naming claims (T-041).

Minor docs-quality observations only, not security findings: orphaned flag tables with no headings near lines 561-577, and duplicated sections for benchmark, update and autoupdate.

No cross-file interactions can be assessed. Source and tests referenced by the doc (Enrollment.swift, ProviderLogout.swift, OpenAIRequestValidation.swift) are not part of the supplied units, so any code change behind these docs needs separate review. Coverage is limited to the doc text.
